name: Martinsmarkt – Antik- und Lifestylemarkt

organiser.name: Cölln Konzept – Agentur für Veranstaltungen (Bruno Deutzmann)

facts: antiques and lifestyle market on Maternusplatz in Köln-Rodenkirchen
the organiser provides the market stalls
tram 16 and 17 to Rodenkirchen Bahnhof; buses 130, 131 and 135 to Maternusplatz
notes: One date only: the market page says 'Termine 2026: So 08.Nov.', and termine.php lists it on the same day. Nothing says it is annual; 'In November' is the most the page supports. No visitor opening hours or entry fee given — only stall set-up Saturday from 17:00 and Sunday from 07:00 — so opening and fee are null. Pitch prices disagree between the market page (15 EUR/m, 4 m hire stall 80 EUR) and termine.php (20,00 / 90,00); not used. Same organiser as our other Cölln Konzept markets. Coordinates: Maternusplatz marketplace node from Nominatim.
